annotations.title: Back up a server's world now

description: Takes a manual backup of the server's current world, which can later be restored or exported. Fails while the server is starting, stopping or restoring, before its first boot, or when the account balance is too low. Returns the backup as pending; listBackups shows it completed when done. Name a backup to the user by its time and reason; never show its backupId.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
